text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわわ！
　
で、
でたー！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Urgh... I-it really is gigantic... But!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっ、
や、
やっぱり大きいです……
けど！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Yeah! As long as I've got you and Mister {0}...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
キョウカとにいちゃんがいれば――！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: As long as I have Misogi and {0}...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ミソギと{0}さんがいれば――！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka & Misogi
text_block_list.orig_text: 怖くなんてないんだから！
